data.briefing: Colombia ranks #20 of 217 on spillover risk in 2025 (score 63, high). It cultivates opium poppy (663 ha in 2018, UNODC). Main outbound corridors: cocaine to ECU, cocaine to PAN. Main inbound corridors: cocaine from PER, cannabis from BRA. Harm reduction in place: syringe programmes, opioid agonist therapy, take-home naloxone, drug consumption rooms.
